test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - General Awareness (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Choose the correct statement regarding the bacterial cell wall.

options.text: Chitin is the major component of the bacterial cell wall.
The major component of the bacterial cell wall is cellulose.
Pectin is the major component of the bacterial cell wall.
The major component of the bacterial cell wall is peptidoglycan or murein.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The major component of the bacterial cell wall is peptidoglycan or murein**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct statement about the bacterial cell wall** is that the major component is peptidoglycan or murein. 
 
• Peptidoglycan **is a polymer made of sugars and amino acids. **
 
• **It's also known as murein. **
 
• The **peptidoglycan sacculus is a bag-shaped structure that surrounds the cytoplasmic membrane. **
 
• **It's made of glycan strands that are cross-linked by short peptides. **
 
• Bacterial cell walls are different from the cell walls of plants and fungi, which are made of cellulose and chitin, respectively. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **bacterial cell wall protects the cell, maintains its shape, and allows the cell to grow, move, and reproduce**.
 
• It also helps** the cell resist osmotic pressure and environmental changes. **
 
• The** cell wall protects the cell from osmotic lysis and sudden environmental changes. **
 
• The cell wall resists osmotic pressure, which can be up to 30 atm. 
 
• The cell wall mediates bacterial interactions with abiotic surfaces.
